items.description: Pre-Owned Nintendo Game Boy Color Clear
items.name: Pre-Owned The Nintendo Game Boy Color, commonly abbreviated as GBC, is a handheld video game console that features a vibrant color screen, offering a significant upgrade from its predecessor. This console is slightly thicker and taller than the Game Boy Pocket, with a slightly smaller screen. It is powered by a custom 8-bit processor, a hybrid between the Intel 8080 and the Zilog Z80, ensuring a classic gaming experience. The Game Boy Color allows for full-color gameplay, displaying up to fifty-six colors simultaneously on screen, and boasts a processor that is twice the speed with quadrupled memory compared to the original Game Boy Pocket.
